Class GameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.controller.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
The master server-side controller within the distributed MVC architecture.

This class isolates and protects the central Game engine instance from concurrent multi-threaded network requests arriving from client connections (via RMI or Sockets). It guarantees atomic execution of game operations by wrapping business logic calls in deterministic, non-fair synchronized block monitors. Additionally, it integrates Jackson annotations to support native JSON deserialization, which enables structural reconstruction of the match session during fault tolerance recovery sequences.

  • Method Details

    • pickCard

      public void pickCard(String nickname, int cardId, int row) throws WrongStateException, WrongTurnException, UnknownPositionException, IllegalPlacementException, UnknownNicknameException, IllegalPickException, ForcedPickException, SQLException
      Forwards a card drafting request initiated by a remote client down into the state machine model.

      This method locks the centralized game monitor to prevent overlapping state mutations if multiple network worker threads invoke actions simultaneously.

      Parameters:
      nickname - the unique user nickname token requesting the draft action
      cardId - the unique catalog identification index number of the chosen target card
      row - the vertical tier index mapping the specific board grid layout component
      Throws:
      WrongStateException - if the underlying game engine is not currently resting in a picking context phase
      WrongTurnException - if the username parameters do not match chronological turn track listings
      UnknownPositionException - if row indices map outside systemic constants boundaries
      IllegalPlacementException - if downstream placement validations veto coordinate parameters
      UnknownNicknameException - if the transmitted username signature fails matching sweeps against registered profiles
      IllegalPickException - if quantitative token allowances inside the player profile are depleted for the chosen row
      ForcedPickException - if rules enforce explicit selection vectors that conflict with this choice
      SQLException - if database transactional logs or status flags encounter underlying infrastructure failures

    • placeTotem

      public void placeTotem(String nickname, char position) throws WrongStateException, WrongTurnException, UnknownPositionException, IllegalPlacementException, UnknownNicknameException, SQLException, IllegalPickException, ForcedPickException
      Routes a totem placement positioning request initiated by a client down into the board tracking model.

      Wraps execution inside a synchronization block to prevent simultaneous token overrides on the shared track pathways.

      Parameters:
      nickname - the unique username signature executing token deployments
      position - the unique character coordinate slot key matching a target path coordinate (e.g., 'B', 'C')
      Throws:
      WrongStateException - if the active game phase rejects totem deployment interactions
      WrongTurnException - if the executing identity's order sequence does not match active turn indicators
      UnknownPositionException - if the character parameter falls outside valid path mappings
      IllegalPlacementException - if the target track coordinate is already claimed by another user's totem
      UnknownNicknameException - if the incoming username token fails validation checks
      SQLException - if network event synchronization hits relational logging failures
      IllegalPickException - if structural sequential triggers cause state conflicts down the pipeline
      ForcedPickException - if boundary tracking conditions veto operations during execution loops

    • onPlayerConnection

      public void onPlayerConnection(String nickname, String totemColor) throws WrongStateException
      Enqueues an inbound connection hook or session recovery signal inside the active game status machine.

      Uses synchronous monitoring to safely register the player profile and assign color configurations. This is especially critical during crash recovery staging sequences (such as WaitingRoomAfterCrashState) to prevent race conditions when compiling reconnected user counts.

      Parameters:
      nickname - the unique textual username signature of the participant joining or returning
      totemColor - the aesthetic color identifier configuration selected for score tracking
      Throws:
      WrongStateException - if connection requests hit the core model when the room lobby parameters are sealed
